diagnosis: Luteinized thecoma associated with sclerosing peritonitis
legend: A densely cellular area (top left) transitions abruptly to an area of marked oedema (bottom right). Nests of weakly luteinized cells are more apparent in the oedematous area but are present throughout the image.

diagnosis: Luteinized thecoma associated with sclerosing peritonitis
legend: The tumor varies from densely cellular to markedly edematous areas, with a microcystic appearance. Clusters of weakly luteinized cells are readily identified at high magnification throughout this tumor.
